content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₇H₁₂N₂O (calculated monoisotopic mass = 140.09496 Da, within ~94 ppm of the observed value and the closest among plausible C/H/O/N candidates). Hence the molecular formula is: C7H12N2O.
